tools.name: read_workout_log
tools.description: Reads a saved workout log file for the user from the workout logs folder and returns its text content.

params.name: log_name
params.description: File name of the workout log to read, e.g. 'week12.txt'

tools.name: summarize_heart_rate_csv
tools.description: Loads a heart rate CSV export from the heart rate data folder and returns the average, minimum and maximum beats per minute.

params.name: filename
params.description: Name of the CSV file in the heart rate folder

tools.name: load_meal_plan_template
tools.description: Loads a meal plan template from the meal plans folder and returns its calories and macros as structured data.

params.name: plan_id
params.description: Identifier of the meal plan template, without the .json extension
